spectral_consequence.statement: the Xi divisor lies on the essential spectrum of the bilateral history generator
spectral_consequence.result: ordinary Fredholmness of P(z) on the Xi seam cannot be obtained by the compact incidence coupling when D_U is an invertible complement

valid_evans_characteristic.multiplicity: the mismatch equals Xi itself, hence preserves every local divisor multiplicity
valid_evans_characteristic.kernel_meaning: at tau(z0)=0 the two stable histories glue to a two-ended H1 state despite z0 lying in continuous spectrum

correction_to_previous_frontier.ordinary_target_rejected: det_F P(z)=c(z)Xi(z) across the seam in unweighted L2
appropriate_targets: the already constructed boundary Evans mismatch E_hist=tau
a limiting-absorption or scattering determinant for the arithmetic coupling relative to the free history operator
a weighted-space determinant with a proved weight-independent seam boundary value

remaining_independence_question.not_missing: Xi-to-triangular-history kernel and multiplicity; these are exact
remaining_independence_question.missing: promotion of the glued two-ended history state to a nontrivial transverse paired arithmetic-Green state under a source-derived lower equation
remaining_independence_question.required_form: a scattering/boundary comparison showing that the arithmetic Green boundary condition is equivalent to the stable-history seam match, without using the canonical identically-zero Stokes codiagonal as the detector

conclusion: The spectral coordinate ambiguity is resolved: Xi zeros occur precisely where the bilateral history block has essential spectrum. The exact Xi characteristic is therefore an Evans seam mismatch, not an ordinary Fredholm determinant of the full or theta-deleted L2 pencil. Future work must use boundary/scattering Fredholm theory and prove arithmetic promotion of that already constructed Evans state.
